execution.producer: foundation/ConfigLoader.js:1071-1077 clones config/settings.json:151-164 into execution, derives brokerMode, and forces candleSource=file only for a backtest launch profile; :1158-1171 exposes the same candle source as mode.candleSource. execution.callbackInit: run-empire-v2.js:691-695 installs candleTimeframe; :852-902 validates the primary pair, creates routable stock contexts from execution symbols, and gives the resulting symbol list to the Alpaca adapter. It retains file source as a separate backtest boundary at :771-775, :1169-1173, and :1663-1669.

broker.reach: provides the broker ID to the runner's runtime scope and MultiAssetManager, decides whether execution.tradingPair is included in the configured-stock guard, and stamps the backtest candle scope. A file-backed descriptor supplies its validated broker identity instead of the root value.

assetClass.reach: sets the runtime and backtest candle asset scope, participates in the configured-stock guard, and selects the non-backtest unified-pattern storage bucket. A file-backed descriptor supplies its validated asset class instead of the root value.

tradingPair.reach: becomes the IndicatorEngine symbol and validated primary runner symbol, is supplied to MultiAssetManager, participates in the stock guard, and names the backtest unified-pattern bucket. A file-backed descriptor supplies its own primary pair.

symbols.reach: is resolved into routable stock symbol contexts and the Alpaca adapter symbol list, and supplies the configured-stock guard. A file-backed descriptor replaces this list and projects it into the matching static stock or crypto session route.

candleTimeframe.reach: sets the IndicatorEngine time base, the runner's active timeframe, each routable symbol context, and the backtest data-file coverage checks. A file-backed descriptor supplies its own candle timeframe.

candleSource.reach: is projected to mode.candleSource. file creates the BacktestRecorder path and suppresses saved-candle loading and REST boot hydration. The root live value is deliberately replaced with derived file only for a backtest launch profile.
